concept: The Proof Loom: a Victorian mathematical plate depicting a transaction Web as a woven body of evidence, engraved with natural-history precision.
composition: Make a wide website-hero plate on deep charcoal. Place an ivory transaction seal just off center beneath a small crescent-and-star. Fine antique-gold and ivory filaments surround and cross the seal, passing over and under in a legible weave. Vary their lengths and weights; let them gather into one coherent field. Leave quiet dark negative space on the left for page copy. Add only sparse construction arcs and engraved ticks.
strands: Each distinct filament represents a proof-bearing Strand attached to the same transaction. Small etched marks may suggest signed intent, contract rule, predecessor state, transition, history, fee bound, or outside observation. Use an open, variable number of unequal strands. They reinforce one another through crossings, with no numbered order or implied common claim.
brandConnection: Use Moriarty’s charcoal, warm ivory, antique gold, and crescent-and-star motif from the banner. Victorian scientific engraving adds a measured, analytical character with restrained gothic intelligence.
avoid: No person, face, city, spider, neon, circuitry, generic node constellation, hub-and-spoke diagram, numbered sequence, fixed strand count, three-proof motif, or pseudo-text. Keep every filament visibly connected to the evidence weave.
imagePrompt: Wide Moriarty website hero, Victorian scientific intaglio engraving titled The Proof Loom: one ivory transaction seal bound by a clearly woven, individually traceable web of varied proof-bearing filaments, crossing over and under, each with subtle evidence marks. Deep charcoal ground, warm ivory etching, restrained antique gold, small crescent-and-star, sparse mathematical arcs, generous dark space on left for copy. Elegant, precise, quietly intelligent. Image only; no lettering, people, city, nodes, neon, fixed strand count, or sequential flow.
